name: Pizza Pazza
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Pizza Pazza in Tirol!**

Discover authentic Italian flair in the heart of the Alps. At **Pizza Pazza**, we bring the taste of Italy to **Tirol**, serving up delicious pizzas, fresh pasta, and crispy calzones—all made with the finest ingredients.

Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a creamy **Burrata Pizza**, our wood-fired oven ensures every bite is a masterpiece. Pair your meal with a cold **Radler** or a glass of crisp Italian wine.

Located in the vibrant city of **Innsbruck**, we’re just a stone’s throw from the **Goldenes Dachl** and the bustling **Herrenstraße**. Stop by for a quick lunch or an evening feast—your taste buds will thank you!

**Pizza Pazza – Where Italian passion meets Tirol’s charm.** 🍕✨
